title: Tyler on several 1940s crashes in New Mexico

tellings.quote: it was a secret place uh on government land it was a New Mexico crash retrieval place and it was a place that you know was not Roswell but this is what Tyler told me he said there were a few crashes that happened in the 1940s

plain: Several crashes of unknown craft are said to have happened in the 1940s at a secret crash recovery site on government land in New Mexico, a place that was not Roswell. Diana Pasulka, a scholar of religion, says she was told this by a source she calls Tyler. If true, it would mean Roswell was not the only crash and the government picked up more than one craft in that decade.
